mapper.select: SELECT gc.JSDW, count(gc.HTBH) HTBHCOUNT, sum(gc.esscjewy) ESSCJESUM FROM TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_ZJB zjb LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ gc ON zjb.GCXMZJID = gc.GCXMZJID WHERE TO_CHAR(gc.CJSJ,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' and zjb.PARENTID is null GROUP BY gc.JSDW

SELECT gc.GCXMZJID, gc.HTBH,gc.GCMC,gc.JSDW,gc.SGDW,zjb.NWB,zjb.EDJE ,gc.ESSCJE FROM TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_ZJB zjb LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ gc ON zjb.GCXMZJID = gc.GCXMZJID WHERE gc.JSDW =#{jsdw} and TO_CHAR(gc.CJSJ,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%'

SELECT gc.SGDW, COUNT(1) AS HTBHCOUNT, SUM(gc.esscjewy) AS EDJESUM, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTOVERNINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 900 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMOVERNINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 100 AND gc.esscjewy < 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTHUNDTONINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 100 AND gc.esscjewy < 900 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMHUNDTONINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 50 AND gc.esscjewy < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTFIFTYTOHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 50 AND gc.esscjewy < 100 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMFIFTYTOHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 20 AND gc.esscjewy < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTTWENTYTOFIFTY, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 20 AND gc.esscjewy < 50 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMTWENTYTOFIFTY, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTUNDERTWENTY, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy < 20 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMUNDERTWENTY FROM ( select CASE WHEN ZJB.NWB in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN '工程建设公司' WHEN zjb.NWB in ('外部单位','外部') THEN '外部单位' ELSE '内部多径单位小计'
END SGDW, gc.esscjewy from TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_ZJB zjb LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ gc ON zjb.GCXMZJID = gc.GCXMZJID WHERE TO_CHAR(gc.CJSJ,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' and zjb.PARENTID is null ) gc GROUP BY gc.SGDW

SELECT gc.JSDW, count(gc.HTBH) HTBHCOUNT, sum(gc.esscjewy) EDJESUM, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ESSCJECOUNT, SUM(gc.esscjewy) - SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS ESSCJESUM, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('外部单位','外部') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EXTERNALUNITCOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB = '外部单位' THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS EXTERNALUNITSUM, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB IN ('腾飞', '内部多径单位', '昆仑投资') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TENGFEIORINTERNALCOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB IN ('腾飞', '内部多径单位', '昆仑投资') THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS TENGFEIORINTERNALSUM, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB = '内部多径单位' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTERNALMULTIPATHCOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB = '内部多径单位' THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS INTERNALMULTIPATHSUM, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('腾飞','昆仑投资') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TENGFEICOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('腾飞','昆仑投资') THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS TENGFEISUM, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ENGINEERINGCONSTRUCTIONCOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS ENGINEERINGCONSTRUCTIONSUM FROM TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_ZJB zjb LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ gc ON zjb.GCXMZJID = gc.GCXMZJID WHERE TO_CHAR(gc.CJSJ,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' and zjb.PARENTID is null GROUP BY gc.JSDW

SELECT gc.JSDW, zjb.NWB,
FROM zjb LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ gc ON zjb.GCXMZJID = gc.GCXMZJID LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_NWB_SORT nwb ON zjb.NWB = nwb.NWB WHERE TO_CHAR(gc.CJSJ,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' and zjb.PARENTID is null GROUP BY gc.JSDW,zjb.NWB ORDER BY gc.JSDW,SORT

SELECT '合计' JSDW, zjb.NWB,
FROM zjb LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ gc ON zjb.GCXMZJID = gc.GCXMZJID LEFT JOIN TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_NWB_SORT nwb ON zjb.NWB = nwb.NWB WHERE TO_CHAR(gc.CJSJ,'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '${queryYear}%' and zjb.PARENTID is null GROUP BY zjb.NWB ORDER BY SORT
mapper.sql: max( nwb.SORT ) as SORT, -- ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(1),2) AS SAMPLINGRATIO, -- SUM(CASE WHEN zjb.NWB not in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ESSCJECOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 0 THEN gc.ESSCJE ELSE 0 END) AS ESSCJESUM, COUNT(1) AS HTBHCOUNT, SUM(gc.esscjewy) AS EDJESUM, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTOVERNINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 900 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMOVERNINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 100 AND gc.esscjewy < 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTHUNDTONINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 100 AND gc.esscjewy < 900 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMHUNDTONINEHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 50 AND gc.esscjewy < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTFIFTYTOHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 50 AND gc.esscjewy < 100 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMFIFTYTOHUND, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 20 AND gc.esscjewy < 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTTWENTYTOFIFTY, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy >= 20 AND gc.esscjewy < 50 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMTWENTYTOFIFTY, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy < 20 or gc.esscjewy IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COUNTUNDERTWENTY, SUM(CASE WHEN gc.esscjewy < 20 THEN gc.esscjewy ELSE 0 END) AS SUMUNDERTWENTY

( SELECT CASE WHEN NWB in ('腾飞','昆仑投资') THEN '腾飞' WHEN NWB = '内部多径单位' THEN '内部多径单位' WHEN NWB in ('工程建设公司','工程建设') THEN '工程建设公司' WHEN NWB in ('外部单位','外部') THEN '外部单位' ELSE '外部单位' END NWB, GCXMZJID,PARENTID FROM TBL_YQNS_GCXMZJ_ZJB)
